title: In the same turn-199 theft, Lys's stated 'Lys disapproves (-1)' also failed to move her regard (stayed -1 before and after, per status). Two companions reacting to one theft event and neither delta landing suggests a bug specific to multi-companion-reaction turns, not just to one companion.
where: Captain Vane's Tent - 'take a bundle of Company tally-sticks'
